name: Dense Bean Salad With Charred Jalapeño-Lime Dressing

ingredients.name: freshly ground black pepper, plus more for garnish
fresh cilantro, plus more for garnish

instructions.primary_message: Halve the cherry tomatoes. Chop the red onion. Stem and halve the jalapeño chile lengthwise, then seed it. Trim the ends of the scallions. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Drain and rinse the pinto beans. Drain and rinse the black beans. Pick the cilantro leaves from the stems and chop them. Crumble the queso fresco.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 oz cherry tomatoes
½ small red onion
1 medium jalapeño chile
2 medium scallions
1 (15 ½ oz) can chickpeas
1 (15 oz) can pinto beans
1 (15 oz) can black beans
½ cup fresh cilantro, plus more for garnish
4 oz queso fresco

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack 6 inches below heat source and preheat oven to broil. In a large bowl, stir together cherry tomatoes, red onion, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Let stand until tomatoes release some juices and onion softens slightly, about 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, on a rimmed baking sheet, place jalapeño, scallions, garlic, and corn, arranging jalapeño cut-side-down and pushing corn kernels to one side of sheet. Broil, stirring corn and turning scallions halfway through, until vegetables are charred in spots, 5 to 8 minutes. Let cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Peel garlic; discard skins. Transfer jalapeño, scallions, and peeled garlic to a blender; set corn aside.

To blender, add lime juice, vinegar, honey, cumin, chile powder, black pepper, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt and blend on high until mostly smooth, about 30 seconds. With blender running, stream in oil and blend until smooth and emulsified, about 30 seconds.
To bowl with salted tomatoes, stir in chickpeas, pinto beans, black beans, cilantro, and reserved charred corn until combined. Gently fold in queso fresco.
Add prepared jalapeño-lime dressing to bean salad and toss to combine. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Garnish with additional cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

schema_metadata.keywords: Dense Bean Salad Recipe, Bean Salad

description: This easy, dense bean salad combines three kinds of beans with charred corn, tomatoes, queso fresco, and a smoky jalapeño-lime dressing for a hearty lunch or side that tastes even better the next day.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice (from 2 limes), plus lime wedges for serving

Make-ahead and storage: The assembled salad can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days before serving.
author: Leah Colins
